title: lsst-impostor-search: a Rubin/LSST search for supernova impostors and LBV eruptions
description: Tools to find eruptive massive stars (supernova impostors and luminous blue variable eruptions) in Rubin Observatory/LSST data. rsp_search/: a Python package and Rubin Science Platform notebooks that search Data Preview 2 by selecting variable DiaObjects, assigning host galaxies and distances from the HECATE catalog, and retrieving forced-photometry light curves. ml/: a machine-learning prototype that fine-tunes the pretrained ORACLE light-curve classifier to recognize simulated eruptions and compares it with training from scratch.
